_note: All tunable numbers live here. Category weights are equal on purpose: no area leads. Changing this file is a rule change and needs the owner's approval.

scoring.hit_definition: play beats the total-market benchmark over its holding period

trust_ladder.when: fewer than 50 resolved forecasts, or no proven edge over base rates
50 or more resolved forecasts and the scoreboard shows the Scout beating base rates with a confidence interval that excludes zero

confidence.A: three or more independent primary sources, a sourced base rate, forecaster spread under 0.15, Red Team verdict KEEP
confidence.B: two independent non-seller sources, a base rate, forecaster spread under 0.25, Red Team KEEP or FIX with fixes applied
confidence.C: anything less: watchlist only, never a sized bet

approach.fast_feedback: short-cycle situations (tender offers, dated catalysts under 90 days) are run on paper every week to build a graded record quickly
approach.capacity_rule: every play states the most dollars it can absorb; sizing uses --capacity

core.active: software_mix (proposed; takes effect when the owner merges)
core.trend_rule: hold the stock block only while the total-return index is above its 10-month average at month end; otherwise cash

funds._note: Candidate funds, fees checked 2026-11-13. Each is a milder, real-world version of its research block. Confirm each is offered at the broker before buying.

stages.name: build
stages.mix: re-chosen by backtest with the worst yearly fall limited to about 30 to 40%

stages.name: protect
stages.mix: re-chosen by backtest with the worst yearly fall limited to about 20%
